content:
alyssa: Heads up — at ~08:12 UTC we're seeing apiserver 503s in asia1. spike in etcd WAL io on the leader, controller-manager restarting a few times. GPU autoscaler is thrashing (scale-up then immediate drain). anyone digging?

mike: on it. I'm seeing `etcd` leader WAL fsync latencies >200ms. K8s apiserver error: `Get /api/v1/... 503`.

jordan: looks correlated with a large batch of GPU instance attaches from dedicated-provisioner between 08:10-08:13. provisioner logs show repeated attach failures then retries.

katie: @mike can you paste the top of etcd logs?

mike: paste: ```
2026-03-21T08:11:57.123Z etcdserver: applied entry took too long [200.457ms]
2026-03-21T08:12:01.890Z WAL: fsync latency 225ms
2026-03-21T08:12:04.334Z raft: increased election timeout due to IO
```

sam: also seeing NAT port exhaustion in asia1-snat pool around same time — lots of short-lived connections during attach flood. nat-monitor shows conntrack high-water.

alyssa: so chain: attach retries -> connect storm (nat/conntrack) -> etcd WAL fsync blowup -> apiserver 503s -> controller-manager restarts -> scheduler backlog -> pods stuck.

jordan: confirmed. provisioner was trying to attach 120 GPUs in a 5m window due to a job rollout. autoscaler policy allowed aggressive burst.

katie: mitigation ideas: 1) throttle provisioner attach concurrency 2) temporarily increase etcd WAL sync budget / move leader 3) enlarge snat pool (short term) 4) pause rollout.

mike: quick mitigations applied: reduced provisioner attach concurrency from 50 -> 8 via emergency config, added connection rate-limit on provisioner, increased conntrack sysctl on edge proxies.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1983 (asia1 apiserver 503s). Pager notified: @oncall-sre.

sam: added firewall rule to redirect attach control-plane traffic to a different egress node to spread SNAT. Not perfect but buys time.

jordan: paused the model rollout and revoked remaining attach attempts. no new attaches in last 30s.

mike: post-change etcd metrics: WAL fsync tail latency down to ~30-40ms. apiserver 503s subsiding. controller-manager restarted but now stable.

alyssa: nice. cost note: that rollout was using extra high-memory GPUs in eu-west fallback which bumped cross-region egress costs when fallback kicked in. we should log cost impact.

katie: opened follow-up ticket: GH-5642 - "provisioner: add attach concurrency cap & backoff hysteresis". also GH-5643 - "deploy planner: avoid global burst rollouts that hit single region".

mike: root cause summary to paste in incident: aggressive attach burst from model rollout + SNAT pool exhaustion + high WAL fsync due to storage IO burst -> etcd leader latency -> apiserver 503s and controller-manager instability.

alyssa: action items: 
- short: keep throttles on provisioner until autoscaler policy updated (mike)
- mid: increase SNAT pool & make conntrack autoscale (sam)
- mid: add provisioner backoff + jitter (jordan)
- longer: move heavy attach workflows to staggered regional batches + cost guardrails on cross-region fallback (katie)

mike: I'm running `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` to confirm controlplane pod health. snippet: ```
NAME                                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
kube-apiserver-asia1-0                     2/2     Running   1          14d   cp-node-asia1-a
kube-controller-manager-asia1-0            1/1     Running   3          14d   cp-node-asia1-a
etcd-asia1-0                               1/1     Running   2          14d   etcd-node-asia1-a
```

katie: recommend we document recommended attach concurrency default in runbook. current default is 50 which is too high for regions with 2-3 NAT-gateways.

sam: FYI cloud billing shows cross-region egress bumped by ~$2.7k in last hour due to fallback attach attempts — filed to incidents-cost for chargeback.

jordan: planning a follow-up postmortem once we stabilize. will include timeline, metrics, configuration diffs, and cost delta.

alyssa: thanks all. keep thread updated if apiserver errors reappear. I'm leaving throttles in place and marking incident P2 for now.

deploy-bot: auto-comment: rollback prevented (deploy paused). CI cancels remaining attach jobs in rollout.
